coverage.checkerSemantics: Unique answer per rules; existing token checker, YES/NO case folding only. No downloaded checker executed.
coverage.inputConstraints:
The first line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) — the number of letters in the mailbox.

The second line contains n space-separated integers (zeros and ones) — the state of the letter list. The i-th number equals either 1, if the i-th number is unread, or 0, if the i-th letter is read. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
